description: This Dart file defines an `OceanTheme` class providing a customized Flutter `ThemeData` for the application's theme, including color schemes, text styles, button styles, and background decorations.

classes.name: OceanTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing theme configuration methods and style constants for the 'Ocean' theme.

methods.name: themeData
methods.description: Returns a `ThemeData` object configured with the Ocean theme's color scheme, typography, and component styles.

methods.name: gradientBackground
methods.description: Builds a `BoxDecoration` with a linear gradient matching the Ocean theme's color palette.

methods.name: softShadows
methods.description: Provides a list of `BoxShadow` objects used for subtle depth effects on UI components.
